shortDescription: Genasys Inc. (NASDAQ: GNSS), the global leader in Protective Communications®, today announced that Genasys Protect® has been integrated with PulsePoint Foundation’s Respond app. PulsePoint Foundation develops technology to help public safety agencies create lifesaving partnerships with their commun…

children: ® has been integrated with PulsePoint Foundation’s Respond app. PulsePoint Foundation develops technology to help public safety agencies create lifesaving partnerships with their communities. The integration embeds Genasys Protect alerts and advisories directly within the PulsePoint Respond app, reaching users in 5,775 communities at launch.

Genasys Protect empowers emergency managers to target specific geographic zones with timely, actionable information and guidance during wildfires, flooding, hazardous material incidents, and other public safety threats. When a Genasys zone overlaps the jurisdictional boundaries of one or more PulsePoint-connected communities, messages are also sent to PulsePoint followers in those communities. PulsePoint directs these users to the Genasys Protect zone map and any agency resources included in the message, such as shelter locations or event landing pages. Throughout the event lifecycle, PulsePoint continues to display the latest Genasys messages and zone statuses within the Respond app.

Richard Price, Founder and President, PulsePoint Foundation, said, “Delivered in partnership with public safety agencies and connected in real time to local 911 systems, PulsePoint Respond is the situational awareness tool millions of community members rely on every day to stay informed about emergencies happening around them. I can’t imagine a more perfect audience for the critical messaging offered by the Genasys Protect Platform.”

Tynan Heller, Director of Product, Genasys Inc., said, “At Genasys, we believe critical information is most effective if it reaches people quickly, clearly, and through channels they trust. PulsePoint has built an extraordinary connection with communities through its real-time public safety awareness platform, making it an ideal partner for extending the reach of Genasys Protect. Together, we're helping public safety agencies deliver actionable information that keeps residents informed, prepared, and safer during emergencies.”

Genasys’ zone-based alerting provides vital advantages during wildfires, flooding, hazardous material incidents, and other public safety threats. By helping deliver the right message to the right people at the right time, Genasys Protect reduces alert fatigue, builds public trust, enhances overall incident response, and saves lives.

PulsePoint Foundation is a public 501(c)(3) nonprofit that builds applications used by public safety agencies to increase community awareness and engagement during critical events. Its flagship PulsePoint Respond app is a 911-connected situational awareness tool that keeps the community informed of nearby emergencies, notifies trained individuals when CPR is needed, and offers a professional version designed for on-duty use by fire and EMS agencies. PulsePoint also administers the National Emergency AED + Resource (NEAR) Registry, which catalogs emergency resources such as AEDs, naloxone, bleeding control kits, and epinephrine, so they can be quickly identified by 911 telecommunicators and responders during cardiac arrests and other time-sensitive medical emergencies. Learn more at pulsepoint.org and near-registry.org.

Genasys is the global leader in Protective Communications®, providing the most comprehensive portfolio of preparedness, response, and analytics software and hardware solutions available. The Company’s Long Range Acoustic Device® (LRAD®) and Protect Platform, which includes Genasys Protect® and Genasys Evertel®, are designed around one premise: ensuring organizations and public safety agencies are Ready when it matters®. Protecting people and saving lives for over 40 years, Genasys covers more than 155 million people in all 50 states and in over 100 countries worldwide. For more information, visit genasys.com.
